name: flow.set lastSpeed
Update Switch State
Set ON/OFF
Update All MQTT Nodes, context names & Dashboard names for each fan
info:
Flow Notes (Fan Control Subflow)
--------------------------------
- Speed > 1 = Fan ON
- Speed = 0 (or 1 due to ESP quirk) = Fan OFF
- Mycodo publishes fan speed → keeps dashboard synced
- Output #2 loops back into dashboard switch to mirror state
- ⚠️ Switch node option "Pass through messages" MUST be OFF
   → Prevents infinite feedback loop when updating state
- MQTT topics use fixed fan_id inside subflow (can’t inherit)
